name: click
description: Real upstream prompt rendering regression fixed by merged PR #3021 on 2025-10-02 (UTC). click.prompt and click.confirm append unwanted whitespace when prompt_suffix is empty. The base is the merge fix's first parent. The regression patch is the complete upstream test-only diff, adding four cases to the existing stream-routing test without adding or duplicating test functions.
question: Fix click.prompt and click.confirm so an empty prompt_suffix is rendered exactly, without an extra trailing space. Preserve normal default prompts, input processing, and the expected stdout/stderr behavior when err=True.
evidence: E       AssertionError: assert 'Prompt to stdin with no suffix ' == 'Prompt to stdin with no suffix'

validation.workspace_metadata: None required for this suite. Click is imported directly from workspace/src; no Click distribution, wheel, editable installation, or build backend is installed.
validation.suite_selection: Entire upstream pytest suite: tests/, 1324 collected items, no explicit exclusions or collection filters. Existing upstream pytest configuration, including warnings-as-errors, is unchanged. The verification suite includes the upstream regression exactly once. It was also tested independently with its node ID.

patch_provenance.checks: Both patch files compare byte-for-byte with these git diffs. Both apply cleanly to fresh base archives in regression-then-repair order. The resulting test file and repaired source file each match the upstream fix blob exactly. CHANGES.rst is intentionally outside both patches.
patch_provenance.shallow_status: Both repositories returned false from git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository before history inspection.

commands.context: All pytest commands run with cwd equal to the relevant workspace. Paths below record the actual validation locations; replace those locations for another machine. Every test process inherits PYTHONPATH=<workspace>/src, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8.

validation.measurement: Wall time uses time.perf_counter around subprocess execution. Output characters are the length of UTF-8 decoded combined stdout/stderr, without added progress, repeated cases, or padding. Output bytes equal characters in these runs. Runtime, temporary paths, and object addresses can vary on reruns.

archive_contract.network_isolation_method: Linux unshare --user --map-current-user --net, retaining uid 1000. This is a validation wrapper, not a required diagnostic or oracle dependency.
archive_contract.baseline_integrity: Hashes frozen after setup; after runs, every preexisting file stays unchanged except the allowed source in repaired workspaces. Fresh base and fixed baseline file hashes match. Oracle uses a third archive with regression.patch and setup, then copies only the allowed source from fixed; all 141 other baseline files remain unchanged. The broken workspace is tested after fixed's setup to detect shared-venv source binding.

known_gaps: 21 upstream Windows-only msvcrt cases skip naturally on Linux: test_getchar_windows (16), test_getchar_special_key_windows (3), test_getchar_windows_exceptions (2). No test selection or configuration was changed.
tests/test_chain.py::test_group_chaining is already marked xfail upstream and remains xfailed in both states.
The historical upstream contract routes the final prompt character to stdout even for err=True; this task preserves the upstream regression assertions rather than redefining that behavior.
Validation covers the entire runtime pytest suite on Linux/Python 3.12.13; it does not run documentation builds or the separate upstream static typing fixtures.
Fresh setup requires network access for pinned PyPI wheels; repeated setup with the same initialized venv and all test commands were verified offline.
